text.p: Falconbridge Ltd said on Friday it has chosen Alex Balogh as acting chief executive officer of the company while it searches for a permanent successor to Frank Pickard, who died suddenly earlier this week.
Balogh is currently chairman of the board of Falconbridge and deputy chairman of Noranda Inc. He was previously president and chief executive officer of Falconbridge from 1989 to 1990.
"It was an obvious and simple choice for the board," spokeswoman Caroline Casselman said in an interview. "He knows Falconbridge well, he knows what we have on our plate currently."
She said she did not know when a permanent replacement for Pickard would be named.
Pickard died suddenly on Wednesday during a routine tour of the company's Collahuasi mine in Chile.
